title.zh: 特罗姆瑟官方旅游指南
公共巴士与渡轮时刻表

summary.en: Tromsø is built on hills. In winter, sidewalks turn into sheets of solid ice. Falls and broken bones are very common among tourists.
summary.zh: 特罗姆瑟建在山坡上。冬季，人行道会变成坚硬的冰层。游客滑倒和骨折的情况非常普遍。

mitigations.en: Wear 'brodder' (spikes/crampons) on your shoes at all times in the city.
mitigations.zh: 在城市中行走时，请务必时刻在鞋上穿戴 'brodder'（防滑冰爪）。
像企鹅一样走路（重心前倾）。

summary.en: Coastal weather is unpredictable. Rain can wash away snow, and cloudy skies often block the Aurora in the city.
summary.zh: 沿海天气不可预测。雨水可能会冲走积雪，多云的天空经常在城市内遮挡极光。

mitigations.en: Book 'Aurora Chase' tours that drive inland (to Finland border) for clear skies.
mitigations.zh: 预订"追光团"，他们会开车前往内陆（至芬兰边境）寻找晴朗的天空。

mitigations.en: Be prepared for tour cancellations due to storms.
mitigations.zh: 做好因风暴导致旅游团取消的心理准备。

items.en: Troms Billett (App for buying bus tickets - cheaper than on board)
items.zh: Troms Billett（购买巴士票的应用 - 比上车买票便宜）

items.en: Troms Reise (App for bus schedules and real-time tracking)
items.zh: Troms Reise（巴士时刻表和实时追踪应用）

items.en: EasyPark (For parking if renting a car - parking is expensive)
items.zh: EasyPark（如果租车，用于停车支付 - 停车费很贵）

items.en: Whale Watching tour (Nov-Jan) - Book 1-2 months ahead
items.zh: 观鲸团（11月-1月）- 提前 1-2 个月预订

items.en: Dog Sledding - High demand, book early
items.zh: 狗拉雪橇 - 需求量大，尽早预订

items.en: Fjellheisen Cable Car ticket (can buy on site, but check wind status)
items.zh: Fjellheisen 缆车票（可现场购买，但需先查看风力状况）

message.en: Whales (Orcas and Humpbacks) migrate. The season is typically late Oct to end of Jan. By February, they are usually gone further north. Tours often involve 2-3 hours of boat travel each way.
message.zh: 鲸鱼（虎鲸和座头鲸）会迁徙。季节通常是 10 月下旬到 1 月底。到了 2 月，它们通常已经向更北处游去。观鲸团通常包含单程 2-3 小时的船程。

askUser.en: Is your trip dates within the whale season (Nov-Jan)?
askUser.zh: 您的旅行日期在观鲸季节（11月-1月）内吗？

message.en: Tromsø has a complex system of underground tunnels WITH roundabouts inside. GPS can lose signal inside. Know your exit beforehand.
message.zh: 特罗姆瑟拥有复杂的地下隧道系统，隧道内部甚至有环岛。GPS 在内部可能会丢失信号。请提前知道您的出口。

title.en: Study the tunnel map if driving
title.zh: 如果开车，请研究隧道地图
